speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. Given your age, heavy smoking history, and the location of these non-healing, crusty lesions, I am concerned about potential malignancy. Can you tell me specifically how long these lesions have been present and if you have noticed any bleeding or pain?
